description: Remote-origin IPC scope for persea instance pages. Grants ONLY core:event:default (listen, unlisten, emit, emitTo) to the origins listed in remote.urls. This file is the single source of truth for which persea instances the shell trusts. build.rs populates remote.urls at build time from src-tauri/remote-urls.txt (one origin per line, scheme://host[:port]; a leading *. is allowed for subdomain wildcards, anything else fails closed). The file is checked in empty: an absent or empty allowlist keeps this empty array, so remote pages get zero IPC and the bridge stays disabled. The bridge re-validates the runtime instance store against this baked list at startup. Do NOT add other permission groups here; the capability diff review checks this file against the locked grant list.
